skill.summary: Provides detailed insights on BASF’s history, global Verbund production model, business divisions, and industrial sustainability in the chemical sector.

latestVersion.changelog:
BASF Group Skill v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Provides a comprehensive overview of BASF’s history, scale, and business model.
- Explains the unique Verbund (integrated production) model, including cost-saving and efficiency details.
- Lists BASF’s six core business segments and key competitive advantages.
- Shares major financial and operational facts as of 2024.
- Includes interesting trivia about BASF’s facilities and origins.
